results.evidence: After the redirect, `sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false)` runs, which closes the panel and so also the overlay. The sceneLayoutLogic source isn't shown, though.
`router.actions.push(urls.insightEdit(newInsight.short_id))` is kept and `lemonToast.success('Insight duplicated')` still runs before it.
The close is unconditional inside `if (redirectToInsight)`. Nothing checks whether the panel is an overlay, and the author admits the panel closes on wide screens too.

The navigation URL is unchanged and carries no short id. The patch looks it up on the transfer page with `insightsApi.getByNumericId(Number(logicProps.resourceId))`. That is a valid alternative if the method exists, but its definition isn't shown.

`insightShortId ? urls.insightView(insightShortId) : urls.savedInsights()` gives the right URL once the short id is loaded. It depends on `insightsApi.getByNumericId`, which isn't visible in the patch or the surrounding code.
The fallback is `insightShortId ? urls.insightView(insightShortId) : urls.savedInsights()`. The loader returns `insight?.short_id ?? null`.
The Dashboard and Survey cases still return `urls.dashboard(resourceId)` and `urls.survey(resourceId)`. The loader returns null for non-Insight kinds, and no URL parameters were added.

The card content is wrapped in `<div className="@container">` with `flex flex-col @md:flex-row gap-3 items-start`. The illustration sits beside the text only at `@md` and wider, and stacks below that.

result:
I fixed all three, but nothing was run or type-checked, so none of it is verified.

- **Duplicate on a narrow screen:** after a successful duplicate with redirect, `duplicateInsight` in `insightLogic.tsx` now closes the scene panel. It does this with `sceneLayoutLogic.findMounted()?.actions.setScenePanelOpen(false)` right after pushing to the new insight. The panel closes on wide screens too, not only narrow ones.
  - `scenePanelOpen` is also true when the side panel is open on its Info tab. I only reset the manual flag, so that case would stay open.
- **Transfer page Back link:** the link built an insight URL from the numeric ID, which the insight page can't load. `resourceTransferLogic` now has a `sourceInsightShortId` loader that runs on mount and looks the short ID up with `insightsApi.getByNumericId`. `ResourceTransfer.tsx` passes it to `urls.insightView(...)`, the same link used elsewhere. If the lookup hasn't finished or fails, Back goes to the saved insights list. I hand-edited the logic's typegen interface to match, so regenerating types may reformat it.
- **Subscriptions empty state:** in `SubscriptionEmptyState` (`SubscriptionOverviewComponents.tsx`), the featured card now sits in an `@container`. The layout is `flex-col @md:flex-row`, so in a narrow modal the illustration stacks above the text. At `@md` and wider it sits beside it as before.

I didn't add tests. The two logic changes are small and the layout change is CSS only.
